name: Stone Giant — the fired picker lists only your creatures with toughness less than its power
notes: Memory: project_stone_giant_toughness_less_than_source_power_2026-10-18. '{T}: Target creature you control with toughness less than this creature's power gains flying until end of turn': the fire-time bound only wrote out a power bound, so 'with toughness less than this creature's power' stayed a required subtype and the picker listed nothing. It is now written as 'with toughness N or less' from the fire-time snapshot. Stone Giant is 3/4, and a +1/+1 counter makes it 4/5 before it fires, so the bound is toughness 3 or less: Grizzly Bears (toughness 2) and Hill Giant (3) are listed; Craw Wurm (4), Stone Giant itself (5) and the opponent's Llanowar Elves are not. The counter shows the bound reads the power after layer 7.
